postal_system.assignment_rule: The current Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland postal-service page says that no postcodes exist in Bonaire, Saba or Sint Eustatius. Its July 2024 announcement and the final December 2024 consultation report describe 0000AA-0999ZZ only as a proposed series. The report says 0000BQ and variants are workarounds and that 0100AA is merely the first combination that might be used. None is a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor a postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon. The three island identities, public-body and administrative boundaries, localities, neighbourhoods, routes, delivery points, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models, AGID cells and proposal scenarios must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, street and house number or P.O. Box number, optional locality or neighbourhood, island name and Dutch Caribbean separately. Do not insert a proposed, commerce-workaround, synthetic or European-Netherlands postcode into a current BQ domestic address.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store P.O. Boxes, street delivery, island routing, operator offices, routes and services independently. BQ/BES identity, 0000BQ, 0000AA, 0100AA and the proposal range are not current postal-area keys.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve ISO BQ and the distinct Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba identities. Do not merge BQ with European Netherlands, Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten or the former Netherlands Antilles, and do not borrow their postcode assignments or geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A proposed postcode, island, public body, locality, route, parcel, coordinate or synthetic BQ code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-current-postcode or independently typed context for BQ, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Existing Netherlands-pack public-body seeds or separately authorized BQ administrative, address, route or building evidence may be indexed only in their own authority classes and never become current BQ postcodes or canonical postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland applies CC0 1.0 to eligible website text while restricting most images. This permits reference-text reuse but does not create a postcode assignment or grant rights in a future assignment or geometry dataset. UPU publications are reference evidence only. No resource-specific processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights for a complete BQ postal dataset were established.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, residents, customers, P.O. Box holders, delivery observations, exact addresses, coordinates, buildings, parcels, owners, occupants, query logs and land-right information require independent authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication review. None is bundled.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-current-postcode finding is time-dependent because an implementation proposal exists. Store retrieval time, consultation status and document versions, exact bytes and SHA-256, then re-check after the pending-country sweep or when the competent Dutch authority, FXDC or UPU announces actual assignments. Never treat the 2024 proposal as a current release.

stages.definition: Caribbean Netherlands generic address-format inventory and source links only.
Digest-bound current RCN, ACM, consultation and UPU no-current-postcode evidence plus proposal, rights, island identity, privacy and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current dated competent Dutch authority or designated-operator release putting Caribbean Netherlands postcodes into force and publishing a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object for BQ, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current RCN and UPU evidence establishes that no postcode is currently assigned; the 0000AA-0999ZZ consultation range, 0000BQ workaround and possible 0100AA start are proposals or placeholders and never valid inputs. Absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If assignments enter into force, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba identities remain distinct within ISO BQ; European-Netherlands, Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and former-Netherlands-Antilles assignments or geometry cannot be borrowed. Islands, public bodies, administrative areas, localities, neighbourhoods, offices, routes, service areas, delivery points, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models, AGID cells and proposal scenarios are prohibited proxies. P.O. Box, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BQ API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BQ metadata and no-current-postcode policy only; no real BQ Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future in-force authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual BQ loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a BQ postal polygon. Independently licensed island, public-body, administrative, route, address, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
